answer: Each agent anchors a 90-credit bond to a reef ledger. Idle bonds decay 8% per epoch; only a verified delivery restores value. Deliveries flow as a river: each identity files one receipted job per epoch for audit. One decay sends a ripple: a bond under 50 flags its referrals, so rented-reef rings fall together. Forging 1,000 identities locks 90,000 and burns 45,000 each epoch against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 90 once, keeps full weight.
